payload.tail_surface: check that the pump is level
conditions: Fasten the pump to the underlying structure (= foundation / concrete plinth / floor)
payload.applicability: pumps with flange support(s) (also applies to horizontal pumps)
payload.evidence_text: 1. Fasten the pump to the underlying structure (= foundation / concrete plinth / floor) and check that the pump is level.

payload.tail_surface: Check that the pump shaft can be rotated freely - i.e. by hand without noise and abnormal resistance.
payload.applicability: pumps with flange support(s) (also applies to horizontal pumps)
payload.evidence_text: 2. Check that the pump shaft can be rotated freely - i.e. by hand without noise and abnormal resistance.

payload.tail_surface: check that the bolt holes are aligned and that the gasket surfaces are parallel.
conditions: Place flange support(s) at the pump’s flange(s)
payload.applicability: pumps with flange support(s) (also applies to horizontal pumps)
payload.evidence_text: 3. Place flange support(s) at the pump’s flange(s) and check that the bolt holes are aligned and that the gasket surfaces are parallel.

payload.tail_surface: it may be necessary to shim under either the pump footplate or under the flange support(s).
payload.applicability: pumps with flange support(s) (also applies to horizontal pumps)
payload.evidence_text: 4. If the underlying structure is not level (plane), it may be necessary to shim under either the pump footplate or under the flange support(s).

payload.applicability: pumps with flange support(s) (also applies to horizontal pumps)
payload.evidence_text: 5. Insert gasket(s) between pump and flange support(s) and hold together and parallel with 4 temporary bolts 90° offset in each flange.

payload.tail_surface: Check that the flange support(s) have full contact with the underlying structure
payload.applicability: pumps with flange support(s) (also applies to horizontal pumps)
payload.evidence_text: 6. Check that the flange support(s) have full contact with the underlying structure (if there is more than a 0.5 mm air gap under the feet, shims must be placed underneath)

payload.head_surface: more than a 0.5 mm air gap under the feet
payload.applicability: pumps with flange support(s) (also applies to horizontal pumps)
payload.evidence_text: if there is more than a 0.5 mm air gap under the feet, shims must be placed underneath

payload.tail_surface: Bolt flange support(s) to underlying structure.
payload.applicability: pumps with flange support(s) (also applies to horizontal pumps)
payload.evidence_text: 7. Bolt flange support(s) to underlying structure.

payload.tail_surface: mount the pipe system flange(s) and gasket(s) against the flange support(s).
payload.applicability: pumps with flange support(s) (also applies to horizontal pumps)
payload.evidence_text: 8. Remove the 4 temporary bolts and mount the pipe system flange(s) and gasket(s) against the flange support(s).

payload.tail_surface: Check that the bolt holes are aligned and that the gasket surfaces are parallel.
payload.applicability: pumps with flange support(s) (also applies to horizontal pumps)
payload.evidence_text: 9. Check that the bolt holes are aligned and that the gasket surfaces are parallel.

payload.tail_surface: Bolt the piping system flange(s) together with the pump and flange support(s).
payload.applicability: pumps with flange support(s) (also applies to horizontal pumps)
payload.evidence_text: 10. Bolt the piping system flange(s) together with the pump and flange support(s).

payload.tail_surface: Check that the pump shaft still can be rotated freely (sound and resistance must not have changed according to point 2).
payload.applicability: pumps with flange support(s) (also applies to horizontal pumps)
payload.evidence_text: 11. Check that the pump shaft still can be rotated freely (sound and resistance must not have changed according to point 2).

payload.head_surface: temperature of the pipe system changes significantly (up or down) after commissioning the pump and consequent thermal stresses / movements in the pipe system, if any, can be transferred to the pump
payload.tail_surface: it should be checked again that the pump shaft still can rotate freely at actual upper/lower temperature limits.
payload.applicability: pumps with flange support(s) (also applies to horizontal pumps)
payload.evidence_text: 12. If the temperature of the pipe system changes significantly (up or down) after commissioning the pump and consequent thermal stresses / movements in the pipe system, if any, can be transferred to the pump, it should be checked again that the pump shaft still can rotate freely at actual upper/lower temperature limits.

payload.head_surface: pump cannot rotate freely under all operating conditions
payload.tail_surface: the pipe system must be better supported
payload.applicability: pumps with flange support(s) (also applies to horizontal pumps)
payload.evidence_text: 13. If the pump cannot rotate freely under all operating conditions, the pipe system must be better supported - alternatively, compensator(s) must be installed between the pump and pipe system.

payload.head_surface: pump cannot rotate freely under all operating conditions
payload.tail_surface: compensator(s) must be installed between the pump and pipe system.
payload.applicability: pumps with flange support(s) (also applies to horizontal pumps)
payload.evidence_text: 13. If the pump cannot rotate freely under all operating conditions, the pipe system must be better supported - alternatively, compensator(s) must be installed between the pump and pipe system.
